avis.texte: This really helps with redness and leaves my daughter's skin looking and feeling clean and soft. She has oily, acne-prone skin and this is helping control it. We ordered online and will continue using it.
Great product, makes my face feel fresh and clean. The only drawback is when the bottle gets low, you do not get a good amount out of the pump.
This toner feels nice on my face. I love the light fragrance. It feels clean and when I use it with the serum, my skin feels moisturized and soft.
Works well with my other facial skin care products, which are Eminence. Works well with your skin prep for makeup.

I use this twice a day and it is enough to cleanse my face completely without stripping it of its natural oils. Smells beautiful, is so gentle yet refreshing, and incredibly nourishing to my skin. Love this!
Nice facial toner. Not too harsh but works and gentle on face.
Gives my skin a fresh feeling after removing a day of makeup. The pump bottle makes dispensing on cotton rounds easy and with less waste.

I purchased the entire cleansing system and was left underwhelmed. The cleanser and toner left my skin not feeling fully clean. The serum pump never worked and I only got a few days of use but that was my favorite. The lotion was too heavy for me. Would be nice if there was a sample of the whole system before purchasing. I normally don't spend much on myself, and to only have a good experience with one product for a few days was SUPER disappointing. Two stars because the few days with the serum were great.
Works well and non-greasy. It also does not sting/burn like some toners are known to do.

I always Love the Cleanser & Toner! Perfect for my skin! The one & only complaint I do have is... it is So difficult to keep purchasing due to the little quantity that is in the bottle. I prefer to saturate my cotton round each time and it becomes much too costly for me! Some nights now I just use the "face mitt". There was a time they sold refill size on the toner. ThankYou

Jane Iredale's toner is the only toner I have ever used. It's light and my face feels super clean following my skincare routine, first using Beauty Prep's facial cleanser, followed by the toner. It took me a while to get used to not using soap and a washcloth, but my skin has never looked better! I would HIGHLY recommend this toner, along with the facial cleanser.
Fresh, clean and refreshing day and night!!! Reordering today!!!
I have not used a toner in years because my last skin care product did not use one. I like that it makes my skin feel clean.
At 65, my face has changed. This toner is amazing! It reduces the look of pores and makes your face look healthier.
Toner is very comforting not at all irritating. Smells lovely.
Just starting using this and have loved the results so far. Skin has been not so oily and makes my makeup easy to apply
I really like this toner. It does not dry out my skin. I also like that it balances the ph of my skin. The downside is that it doesn't last very long. I wish the bottle was larger. Great smell!

I have bought the toner many times and Love it. I really do miss the refill size and hope they return this to their product choice. So many toners over the years have been very drying..... Not this one!!!
This is the best toner ever. It's clean, crisp and smells natural. Moisturizes the skin beautifully. I like the fact there are only natural occurring ingredients in Jane Iredale's products.

avis.titre: Don't ever discontinue this, please! I love it!
avis.texte: It's just right...nice scent, not to harsh but does the job! Thank you!
I love my new skincare products. Nothing stings or itches. I've had a lot of problems with skincare products, but it seems I may have found what I need.

Nice light fragrance-plumps my lines so they are less noticeable and provides a good make-up base. It is a skin care basic and I use it everyday. My friends ask me how I have such smooth skin! I am over 65 so this is an anti-aging step in my skincare routine!
Love this toner! Leaves face feeling refreshed & oh so clean! Perfect prep for moisturizers & serums!

I love this toner and the way it makes my skin feel. I also love that when you pump it just sitting on the counter it has a slight cup shape to it, so I pump once and pour into my hand and spread all over my face. There is no need for a cotton ball.

Your skin is complete with this toner after cleansing with micellular water! It really makes a difference on my skin because it helps retain some of the moisture that was stripped from using the micellular water.
Feels soothing on my skin. I use it after I use the mitt or after using the beauty prep face cleanser. And, it doesn't cause issues for my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: This toner is a must in your regimen!
avis.texte: This toner really does prepare my skin for hydration spray, moisturizer, make-up or just sun screen.

Toner itself is wonderful! But, it is very difficult for the toner to come out of the bottle. I gave it a 3 for that reason. Very frustrating to get it out and would give your method to do so a 1. Toner is a 5; acquisition a 1.
This toner is wonderful and has a very nice built in application device.

I absolutely love how this product is pursued right after the Jane Iredale BeautyPrep Face Cleanser. One of the main reasons' why I highly recommend the Face Toner is because it cleans up any excess residue especially around my neck region. Thank you.

I have been using the skincare system for over a year and it has made a huge improvement in the redness and texture of my skin. The toner is refreshing and gentle. I sometimes wonder if I really need it in addition to the cleanser, but it usually still removes some of the makeup/grime that the cleanser didn't. Love the unique pump dispenser.

avis.titre: I almost didn't buy this…..but, Idid and…..
avis.texte: I love this product! It has a cooling effect, smells great, and leaves your skin feeling fresh and ready for moisturizer and sunscreen.

avis.titre: Love the toner and love the bottle dispenser
avis.texte: Great product, my rosacea is tolerating this and I love the dispenser bottle, easy to control and use!!!

I use this after my AM face cleaning - as it feels very nice, light and has a lovely smell. You only need a little bit and it goes a long way. Part of my morning facial routine - followed by Jane's moisturizer!

As other reviewers say, this is amazing! Very easy dispenser. All toners should come in this type of bottle! It's not same as the travel size. I love it. Smell is also great. I've never been this happy with the prep toner especially around the side of my nose. It makes makeup application much easier and smoother. Highly recommend!!! and I'm impressed how quickly JI beauty adviser got back to me. Thank you!

I got a travel size of this line of BaeutyPrep. I always like Jane Iredale makeup and was so excited to try the skincare products. I thought it would be a perfect size for travel, but the container doesn't shut well. It is closed, but it somehow leaks. It wasn't an air travel, just transporting in my cosmetic bag. I didn't lose the whole liquid though. It's just disappointing that other items got wet in the bag. If it's a screw-top or something more secure, I would purchase it.
I really haven't noticed much change in my skin. Not sure how my skin should be after using it.
Can't really determine yet how effective it has been but love the dispenser bottle. Great design, wish other skin care lines would follow suit.
Love this product. Makes my face feel fresh and energized. It doesn't sting when applied either. Its fragrance is clean and very pleasant.
I don't want to waste a drop of this elixir. I pump two times to fill the cap well, then put it into a small shot glass. That way i can spread every bit nicely over face and throat. Dreamy
Toner does not strip oils from my face or make my face feel dry or tight.

I put it in a spray bottle and use about 3 to 4 sprays for my entire face. It makes my face feel refreshed, especially in the morning.I use it twice a day. I have very sensitive skin and it is not irritating.

avis.titre: Fabulous partner to the Jane Iredale Cleanser/Micellar Water
avis.texte: Smells lovely without any perfume fragrance to which I am terribly allergic. I use this morning and night (two pumps on a round cotton pad) after using the cleanser and neither are drying at all. At night after removing my makeup with a creamy makeup remover in a jar, I sometimes will just use the toner. If it is a full makeup day, I will use both cleanser and toner after rinsing the remover from my face. This is a pair of products that work beautifully together. Jane Iredale Cleanser and Toner are both winners and work so much better for my skin than what I have been using for years…I have already bought my second set so I will always have both on hand and not run out!!
Love this toner! It has cleared up my skin. Not too drying, my skin feels refreshed.
Always love how my skin feels after using Beauty Prep Face Toner.

Not sure what the difference is between the face toner and face cleanser. The toner has a less pleasant smell and leaves a residue on my skin. On the good side, the toner does not dry out my skin. The residue seems to help moisturize a bit maybe.
This toner is a wonderful product with a light clean fragrance.
The Beauty Prep Face Toner is very refreshing. I use it with other Beauty Prep products.
The toner has really helped my skin feel fresh! At my age, I thought breakouts didn't happen, but I was wrong. I no longer am having any problems with breakouts!
I love how this toner makes my skin feel. I use it as part of the skin care regimen. My skin looks so much brighter and feels soft.
I have enjoyed this paired with the skin cleanser and moisturizer.
This is my newest favorite product. This toner is light and really helps my face feel clean and ready for the next part of my facial routine. So glad I found this product!
This toner, used first thing in the morning, makes my face feel refreshed before applying moisturizer then foundation.
works well in face preparation for makeup and as just good daily skin care .

avis.titre: This one product makes the most difference overnight!
avis.texte: I use the Beauty Prep cleanser, toner, and moisturizer. The moisturizer is a bit heavy for me but works well for nighttime only. The cleanser is really great at removing EVERYTHING easily. But this TONER! It is lightweight, smells great, and REALLY makes a difference. When I use this at night (Hey I am a Gen X - we don't follow our skincare routines like we should), the next morning my skin looks more supple, younger, and smoother. It really is my personal miracle product. It does not dry out your face at all, even if you use it morning and night. I have oily T zone and dry/normal cheeks, and this product works well for me.
This toner works great! It's very gentle and doesn't cause any irritation to my sensitive skin.
Serum has not lessened wrinkles.! Mascara has lumps that make it messy! Moisturizer really makes skin feel good! Toner gives me a good oil balance!
This is perfect for my super sensitive skin. It smells nice and feels good after using. Again, the biggest draw back is the price point.

avis.titre: Needs to have a refillable option
avis.texte: I like the contents, but I am embarrassed by the packaging. This product should at least have a refillable option.The large bottle lasts about a month of w daily use. Then it will be time to send the package into the waste stream and order another cylinder of plastic; repeat monthly. Shameful.

I like the toner but the plastic bottle it comes in is very hard not does not dispense the liquid well at all. I wish it came in a larger size & easier to dispense. One cotton ball does not cover the whole face.

avis.titre: Good product in a not-so-good dispenser
avis.texte: I like this toner, I really do, but I really do not like the dispenser. too much plastic,not refillable and the dispenser is just kind of awkward to use. I tried refilling and empty hydration spray bottle, but it is not exactly right either because it is hard to enough on the cotton ball to make it around your face without multiple pumps.
Love the way this toner makes my face feel. I use it before applying moisturizer in the morning and following cleansing at night. The pump container is hugely helpful to me!
This toner is part of my skin care routine morning and night. My skin is even and very healthy

This is such a refreshing and light toner that doesn't burn. Due to sensitivities and allergies to cosmetics and skincare, I typically don't use toners. I started the complete skincare line for a month and my skin hasn't felt or looked better. So happy to have found Jane Iredale!

I've been using this for several weeks, and it is a great daily use toner. I have combination, acne-prone skin and prefer toners that are gentle and non-drying. This one is perfect! No major breakouts and my skin always feels clean and balanced after use. The light citrus fragrance is lovely too. Will purchase again!
I received the toner and was a bit shocked on how small it was.

avis.titre: Just right kind of Face Toner
avis.texte: Love the BeautyPrep Face Toner...Absoulutely Love the dispenser it has also! I have normal/dry skin and is just perfect. Does not dry skin out at all as some toners do.

avis.titre: Toner- time to stop skipping it!
avis.texte: I haven't used a toner in years, as I'm usually lazy and skip this step. But I decided to try it, and I love the way it makes my skin feel brighter and balanced.
I have never been a toner person, but this product has been great and I love it! Using it twice a day to help my moisturizer work better!

avis.titre: Excellent prep for moisturizer and makeup.
avis.texte: Prepares my skin for moisturizer and feels great on the skin.

I have been using this toner for about a month and all of a sudden I'm noticing my dark spots lightening substantially. I haven't added anything else into my skin regime recently so I can only attribute the change to this toner. I have one really dark freckle on my cheekbone that drives me crazy but oh my goodness, it is so light now I barely notice it! Thank you Jane Iredale for this amazing product!!
I gave this 5 stars because I like it…BUT it does not come completely full and they will have to provide a refill because the pump inside can't be cheap to make.
Love the Toner, it refreshes my face. I tend to use just this product in the morning followed by the tinted/spf Dream Tint. I also use at night after I cleanse.
This is essential after washing your face to bring back it's moisture - definitely feels rejuvenated

This face toner makes my sensitive skin feel soft and refreshed and I can use daily - sometimes several times a day - without my skin becoming irritated or dry. In fact it seems to calm my skin. The only drawback I see is the dispenser. Although I appreciate the lack of waste with the pump, I am trying to use less cotton pads and throw-aways out of environmental concerns and you really do need to use a pad and not your palm or fingers to get the toner out of the bottle.

Not sure why this is better than the drug store Micellar water products, but I have faith in the brand. It is too expensive, so not sure how long I'll be using it, but I love how it works with the Magic Mitt

I've been using the face toner for a few years. Now, especially, with the pandemic and restrictions, using the toner makes me feel so much better - fresh and renewed. Thanks for the product and many more months and years of freshness.

avis.titre: Exactly what I look for in a toner
avis.texte: Best toner for my sensitive dry skin. Feels so soothings and refreshing.
For years, I've skipped a toner, especially as my skin has gotten drier with age. But I like how this prepares my skin for moisturizer.

This is a very mild toner.. fragrance is not too strong. It leaves my face smooth - not dry or tight. I like Jane's products, but I'm not sure it is something I will order again. I'll have to continue using it to decide.
This toner is not at all drying like toners of other brands. It's refreshing and somehow hydrating. I pair it with the other skincare products by Jane Iredale and I love them all. My skin is so soft.

I have been using this toner for many months and absolutely love it!! What I love the most is that it's made from all natural ingredients, unlike others I researched that contain countless preservatives and mystery chemicals. It feels (and smells) clean and refreshing. It's light weight and has definitely made my skin look healthier. I would highly recommend! I won't ever been shopping around for toners again, now that I found this one!

I've been using Jane Iredale Products for a couple of years now. I love every product I have tried. My skin feels refreshed, soft and moisterized. I experienced redness on my face that was exhausting to try to calm down. Since I found Jane Iredale, I have not experienced any redness. Great natural product. Don't have to worry about the ingredients in the product.
It works really well with oil control of my skin. I use this twice a day after I use the face wash and I think it's been working well for me.

avis.titre: Great toner - works well with JI prep products
avis.texte: Love the scent and the way it cleans the remaining residue of makeup off after cleansing with makeup remover wipes.

I love they way this toner makes my skin feel refreshed. It also gets any off any makeup left behind after cleansing. I was so happy with this toner that I bought the cleanser. This is my "dynamic duo" of skin care!

I only started using this a week ago, but I can already tell a big difference! I have never used a toner before, so I don't have anything to compare it to, but this one was great and I will definitely continue using!

I noticed right away the difference in my skin. The lines around my lips are getting smaller. The natural ingredients work well on more mature skin. Not having alcohol in the toner has made a big difference. I signed up for auto delivery so that I will never run out. The travel set is a great way to try all the Beauty Prep products.
Emailant part of my AM face routine. Use Jane's cleanser, followed by the toner and my skin feels clean and healthy.

avis.titre: Like Visiting the Spa w/o Leaving Your Home!
avis.texte: I am in love with this stuff! I've used so many different toners in the past (high-end and low-end) and this beats them all, no question. My favorite way to use it is first thing in the morning after I step out of the shower with a freshly washed face and clean hair. It really lives up to the name "BeautyPrep" by giving me a fresh canvas to work with before putting on my makeup in the morning. It leaves my face and neck feeling baby smooth! I know what I'm getting my girls for Christmas this year...
I have been using this toner for awhile now and just love the way it makes my skin feel and keeps my makeup in place all day.
This has a nice smell and doesn't dry my skin. I don't know if it does anything radical but my skin is happy
I have rosacea and was always hesitant to try a toner.This product is quite gentle....leaves my skin refreshed and glowing.

Pros: I love the design of the container. It is very easy to get the perfect amount out without spillage. Recommendations: I think this is a great product for someone to use with the BeautyPrep Cleanser in the AM (after washing face in the PM the night before). Otherwise, this is a great product for someone who never wears makeup.
I love this toner!!! It makes my makeup go on so so smooth. Absolutely love this toner!!
This is a must to use. I tried not using it, but found my skin care routine was lacking. I am glad I went back to using it.
